snippet.title: Shadow Recompiled - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Shadow Recompiled is an unofficial PC port of the original Xbox version of Shadow the Hedgehog (2005) created through the process of static recompilation. The port supports Windows and Linux.

https://github.com/FoxWorkshop/ShadowRecomp

Trailer by Amosohto
